response.text: Sorry to hear the knee's been sore. I can describe what the engine is doing about it, but a soreness pattern that persists or worsens is worth taking to a qualified clinician. From your profile the knee is on your declared limitations list, so accessories that load it heavily (high-strain plyometrics, deep front-loaded variants) are filtered out of the picker, and the knees & quads region freshness is sitting in the recovering band — which means the engine is already softening high-impact work for the next few sessions.
